question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is: **to.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"to"** is a preposition used to indicate direction, place, or position. (की ओर, पर, को)

 
 
• **Example: **She went to the market to buy some groceries.
 
 
 
• In the given context, **"to"** is the correct preposition to use with the verb "select." It indicates the action of choosing an option from the given list. (की ओर, पर, को)
 
 
• **Example: **Please select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **for** (के लिए): Used to indicate the purpose or reason.

 
 
• **Example:** This gift is for you.
 
 
 
• **in** (में): Used to indicate location or position within something.
 
 
• **Example:** She lives in New York.
 
 
 
• **of** (का, की, के): Used to indicate possession, belonging, or origin.
 
 
• **Example:** He is the owner of the car.
